question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

An exaggerated statement not to be taken seriously or literally
solution:
The correct answer is 'Hyperbole'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The one word for 'An exaggerated statement not to be taken seriously or literally' is :
 
• **Hypertext** :** Hypertext** refers to a word, phrase or chunk of text that can be linked to another document or text.(वाक्यांश या पाठ का हिस्सा है जिसे किसी अन्य दस्तावेज़ या पाठ से जोड़ा जा सकता है।)
 
• **Hyperbole : **Hyperbole is an intentional, obvious exaggeration, or exaggerated statements or claims not meant to be taken literally(किसी वस्‍तु की विशेषता को बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर बखान करने का ढंग, अतिशयोक्तिपूर्ण कथन; अतिशयोक्ति).
 
• **Hypocrisy : **behaviour in which somebody pretends to have moral standards or opinions that he/she does not really have.(उच्‍च नैतिक मानदंड और व्‍यवहार का ढोंग रचना; पाखंड, ढोंग, मिथ्‍याचार)
 
• **Hippocrates : **an ancient Greek scientist who studied and taught medicine.
 
• Therefore, from all the given meanings, we are clear that one word for the given statement is 'hyperbole'.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**
